introHtml: Custom school kits with zipper closures offer added security and organization for students and staff. Unlike open-top kits, the zipper keeps contents like pencils, notebooks, and calculators safely enclosed during daily commutes. Perfect for back-to-school promotions, school district giveaways, or employee education programs. Choose from various colors and imprint options to match your branding needs.
